In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, smart ring maker Oura filed an initial public offering to sell 13.5M shares of common stock and another 36.5M from selling shareholders at a price between $40 and $44 per share.
The offering is expected to raise $2.2B.
which has indicated an interest in purchasing up to $100M of shares, and Dragoneer Investment Group, which intends to buy $300M in shares.
Oura will be represented in the sale by a group of investment banks led by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and J.P. Morgan. The company will be listed on the Nasdaq exchange under the symbol “OURA.”
A date for the offering has not been announced.

title: Oura and selling shareholders list 50M shares for initial public offering
